mapper.select: SELECT A.EMP_ID ,A.CO_ID ,B.CO_NM ,A.MN_ROLE_TP ,A.EMP_NM ,A.EMP_STATUS ,A.DEPT_NM ,A.OFC_PHN_NO ,A.MBL_PHN_NO ,A.EMAIL ,A.SMS_RCT_YN ,A.EMAIL_RCT_YN ,A.REG_ID ,A.REG_DT ,A.UPD_ID ,A.UPD_DT FROM TB_OREM001 A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ORCP001 B ON A.CO_ID = B.CO_ID WHERE A.EMP_ID = #{employeeId}
SELECT COUNT(A.EMP_ID) FROM TB_OREM001 A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ORCP001 B ON A.CO_ID = B.CO_ID

SELECT A.EMP_ID ,A.CO_ID ,B.CO_NM ,A.MN_ROLE_TP ,A.EMP_NM ,A.EMP_STATUS ,A.DEPT_NM ,A.OFC_PHN_NO ,A.MBL_PHN_NO ,A.EMAIL ,A.SMS_RCT_YN ,A.EMAIL_RCT_YN ,A.REG_ID ,A.REG_DT ,A.UPD_ID ,A.UPD_DT FROM TB_OREM001 A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ORCP001 B ON A.CO_ID = B.CO_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_USAU001 U ON U.USER_ID = A.EMP_ID
ORDER BY A.EMP_NM ASC ORDER BY A.EMP_NM DESC ORDER BY B.CO_NM ASC ORDER BY B.CO_NM DESC ORDER BY U.LST_LOGIN_DT ASC ORDER BY U.LST_LOGIN_DT DESC ORDER BY A.REG_DT DESC
LIMIT #{searchCond.pageItemSize} OFFSET #{searchCond.start}

SELECT A.EMP_ID ,A.CO_ID ,B.CO_NM ,A.MN_ROLE_TP ,A.EMP_NM ,A.EMP_STATUS ,A.DEPT_NM ,A.OFC_PHN_NO ,A.MBL_PHN_NO ,A.EMAIL ,A.SMS_RCT_YN ,A.EMAIL_RCT_YN ,A.REG_ID ,A.REG_DT ,A.UPD_ID ,A.UPD_DT FROM TB_OREM001 A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ORCP001 B ON A.CO_ID = B.CO_ID WHERE A.CO_ID = #{companyId} AND A.MN_ROLE_TP = #{roleType, typeHandler=UserRoleTypeHandler}

SELECT A.EMP_ID ,A.CO_ID ,A.MN_ROLE_TP ,A.EMP_NM ,A.EMP_STATUS ,A.DEPT_NM ,A.OFC_PHN_NO ,A.MBL_PHN_NO ,A.EMAIL ,A.SMS_RCT_YN ,A.EMAIL_RCT_YN ,A.REG_ID ,A.REG_DT ,A.UPD_ID ,A.UPD_DT FROM TB_OREM001 A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ORCP001 B ON A.CO_ID = B.CO_ID WHERE A.MN_ROLE_TP = 'ROLE_ADMIN' AND B.CO_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{companyName}, '%')

SELECT A.EMP_ID ,A.CO_ID ,B.CO_NM ,A.MN_ROLE_TP ,A.EMP_NM ,A.EMP_STATUS ,A.DEPT_NM ,A.OFC_PHN_NO ,A.MBL_PHN_NO ,A.EMAIL ,A.SMS_RCT_YN ,A.EMAIL_RCT_YN ,A.REG_ID ,A.REG_DT ,A.UPD_ID ,A.UPD_DT FROM TB_OREM001 A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ORCP001 B ON A.CO_ID = B.CO_ID WHERE A.EMP_ID IN
#{item}

SELECT A.EMP_ID ,A.CO_ID ,B.CO_NM ,A.MN_ROLE_TP ,A.EMP_NM ,A.EMP_STATUS ,A.DEPT_NM ,A.OFC_PHN_NO ,A.MBL_PHN_NO ,A.EMAIL ,A.SMS_RCT_YN ,A.EMAIL_RCT_YN ,A.REG_ID ,A.REG_DT ,A.UPD_ID ,A.UPD_DT FROM TB_OREM001 A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ORCP001 B ON A.CO_ID = B.CO_ID WHERE A.CO_ID = #{companyId}
SELECT A.EMP_ID ,A.CP_ID ,B.CP_NM FROM TB_OREM002 A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CHCP001 B ON A.CP_ID = B.CP_ID WHERE EMP_ID = #{employeeId}
